One of the best street food of our HCM street food tour
May 2016 • Friends
I signed up for the 'Back of the Bike' street food tour in Ho Chi Minh, where they take you around in a scooter to different districts within the city to sample the best of local street food. 
Thit Heo Xiên Nướng Hà Nội was one of the highlights. This is a street food stall where you sit on low plastic stools and the stall vendor serves only one dish which he truly excels in: BBQ pork skewers (similar to satay).
Some of the best street food in Vietnam are stalls selling only a single dish. The skilled hawker does only one dish all his life, and mastered that very one dish (reminds me of Malcolm Gladwell's 10,000 hours of practice rule for mastery).
The "ambience" is gritty, you eat on the street side on low plastic stools and just dig into freshly grilled pork skewers and pork balls washed down with a cold Vietnamese beer. Anthony Bourdain claimed that some of the best meals he's ever had were in Vietnam sitting along the streets on low plastic stools amid diesel fumes. This could be one of them.
The stall opens around 4 pm and closes when it sells out, which is typically around 9 pm.
Tip: no reservations required obviously, but get your hotel concierge to call ahead to check that the stall is open.
